title: 第23章 五国使团齐聚京城第24章 黑日国使者挑衅龙国
lines: 花灯节的余温尚未散尽，一则重磅消息便如同惊雷般炸响了整个天元学府。五国使团同时抵达龙国京城，名义上是为了庆祝龙国建国五千年，实则各怀鬼胎，暗流涌动。
七人小队正在宿舍讨论昨日花灯节的趣事，张二狗还在为猜灯谜作弊被抓的事情耿耿于怀，悟空则在炫耀自己给柳若兮买的兔子灯。突然，宿舍门被猛地推开，一个同学气喘吁吁地跑了进来。“大事不好了，五国使团全都到京城了，听说黑日国的国师龟先生也来了。”
众人脸上的笑容瞬间凝固。庄周的心脏猛地一沉，噩梦中的血色画面再次在脑海中闪过。他攥紧了拳头，指甲深深嵌入掌心。他知道，灭国的倒计时，已经正式开始了。
京城早已张灯结彩，处处洋溢着喜庆的氛围，可在这片虚假的繁华之下，却弥漫着一股令人窒息的压抑感。街道上随处可见巡逻的士兵，城门处的检查也比往日严格了数倍。五国使团的到来，给这座千年古都蒙上了一层阴影。
黑日国使团走在最前面，所有人都穿着黑色的和服，面色阴沉，一言不发，眼神中带着毫不掩饰的轻蔑与杀意。为首的使者身材矮小，眼神阴鸷，腰间挎着一把武士刀，走路时悄无声息，如同鬼魅一般。
紧随其后的是鹰国使团，他们穿着笔挺的军装，个个身材高大，神情傲慢，身后跟着数十名全副武装的士兵，手中拿着最先进的火枪，金属的光泽在阳光下闪闪发光，散发着冰冷的杀气。
欧国使团则显得优雅许多，所有人都穿着华丽的礼服，头戴礼帽，举止彬彬有礼。为首的欧国王子金发碧眼，面容俊朗，嘴角始终挂着一抹迷人的微笑，可眼底深处却藏着一丝不易察觉的贪婪。
佛国使团走在最后，他们穿着黄色的僧袍，双手合十，口中念念有词。为首的高僧须发皆白，面容慈祥，眼神深邃，仿佛能看透世间一切，他的身上散发着一股淡淡的佛光，让人不由自主地心生敬畏。
五国使团同时抵达，引起了京城百姓的围观。大家议论纷纷，有人觉得这是龙国国力强盛的象征，五国都来朝贺，也有人隐隐觉得不安，觉得五国此次前来，恐怕没安什么好心。
皇宫内，龙行步正在设宴款待五国使团。大殿之上，歌舞升平，美酒佳肴琳琅满目，可气氛却异常诡异。五国使者表面上恭敬有加，频频举杯向龙行步敬酒，实则都在暗中观察着龙国君臣的一举一动。
丞相作为主和派的代表，脸上堆满了谄媚的笑容，不停地向五国使者示好。“各位使者远道而来辛苦了，我代表龙国欢迎各位的到来，希望我们两国能够永结同好，共享太平。”
黑日国使者放下酒杯，皮笑肉不笑地说道。“丞相大人客气了，我们此次前来，正是为了与龙国缔结百年和平盟约。只要龙国愿意答应我们的条件，我们保证，百年之内绝不侵犯龙国一寸土地。”
龙行步闻言大喜，连忙说道。“好，好，只要能实现和平，一切都好商量。”
袁天罡站在一旁，眉头紧锁，眼神警惕地扫过五国使者。他能感觉到，这些人的身上都散发着浓郁的杀气，尤其是黑日国使者，身上的血腥味几乎掩盖不住。他知道，一场巨大的灾难，正在悄然逼近。
宴席结束后，袁天罡立刻求见龙行步，想要再次劝谏，可龙行步却以身体不适为由，拒绝了他的求见。袁天罡站在皇宫门口，望着巍峨的宫殿，长长地叹了一口气，眼神中充满了绝望。
天元学府内，七人小队也在讨论着五国使团的事情。“我总觉得这些人来者不善。”杨戬皱着眉头说道。“尤其是那个黑日国的使者，看人的眼神就像毒蛇一样，让人浑身不舒服。”
“怕什么，有我们四大战神在，他们还能翻了天不成。”悟空满不在乎地说道。“要是他们敢耍什么花样，我一棒子就把他们的脑袋打碎。”
“话不能这么说。”庄周摇了摇头。“五国此次同时前来，肯定是早有预谋，我们不能掉以轻心。”
小蝶紧紧地抓着庄周的衣角，眼神中充满了恐惧。“庄周，我好害怕，我总觉得有什么不好的事情要发生了。”
庄周轻轻拍了拍小蝶的头，柔声安慰道。“别怕，有我在，我会保护你的。”
可他的心里，却充满了不安。他知道，四大战神再强，也抵挡不住五国的阴谋诡计，抵挡不住那早已布好的屠国杀局。他看着窗外阴沉的天空，眼神中充满了迷茫与痛苦。难道，真的只能眼睁睁地看着悲剧发生吗？
content_en:
Before the lingering warmth of the Lantern Festival had dissipated, a piece of bombshell news exploded like thunder throughout Tianyuan Academy. The envoys from the five countries arrived at the capital of the Dragon Kingdom at the same time, nominally to celebrate the 5000th anniversary of the founding of the Dragon Kingdom, but in fact they had their own agendas and undercurrents.
The seven-member team was discussing interesting things about yesterday's Lantern Festival in the dormitory. Zhang Ergou was still brooding over being caught cheating in guessing lantern riddles, while Wukong was showing off the rabbit lantern he bought for Liu Ruoxi. Suddenly, the dormitory door was pushed open violently, and a classmate ran in panting. "Something bad has happened. All the envoys from the five countries have arrived in the capital. I heard that Mr. Turtle, the national master of the Black Sun Kingdom, is also here."
The smiles on everyone's faces froze instantly. Zhuang Zhou's heart sank suddenly, and the bloody scene from the nightmare flashed through his mind again. He clenched his fists and dug his nails into his palms. He knew that the countdown to the destruction of the country had officially begun.
The capital has long been decorated with lights and colorful decorations, and there is a festive atmosphere everywhere, but under this false prosperity, there is a suffocating sense of depression. Patrolling soldiers can be seen everywhere on the streets, and inspections at the city gate are several times stricter than in the past. The arrival of the missions from the five countries cast a shadow over this thousand-year-old capital.
The Black Sun Kingdom delegation walked at the front. Everyone was wearing black kimonos, with gloomy expressions and silent words. There was undisguised contempt and murderous intent in their eyes. The leader of the messenger was short in stature, with sinister eyes, and carried a samurai sword on his waist. He walked quietly, like a ghost.
They were followed closely by the Eagle Nation envoys. They were all tall and looked arrogant in straight military uniforms. Behind them were dozens of fully armed soldiers, holding the most advanced muskets in their hands. The metal's luster shone in the sun, exuding a cold murderous aura.
The European mission was much more elegant, with everyone wearing gorgeous gowns and top hats, and behaving politely. The leader of the European prince had blond hair and blue eyes, and a handsome face. He always had a charming smile on his lips, but there was an imperceptible greed hidden deep in his eyes.
The Buddhist delegation walked at the end. They were wearing yellow monk robes, with their hands clasped together and chanting something. The leading monk has white beard and hair, a kind face, and deep eyes, as if he can see everything in the world. His body exudes a faint Buddha light, which makes people involuntarily feel awe.
The envoys from the five countries arrived at the same time, causing people in the capital to watch. Everyone was talking about it. Some people thought that this was a symbol of the Dragon Kingdom's strong national power. All the five countries came to congratulate. Some people felt faintly uneasy and felt that the five countries came this time without any good intentions.
In the palace, Long Xingbu was hosting a banquet to entertain the envoys from the five countries. Above the main hall, there was singing and dancing, and there was a dazzling array of wine and delicacies, but the atmosphere was extremely strange. On the surface, the envoys from the five countries were very respectful and frequently raised their glasses to toast Long Xingbu, but in fact, they were secretly observing every move of the king and ministers of the Long Kingdom.
As the representative of the peace faction, the prime minister had a flattering smile on his face and kept showing his goodwill to the envoys from the five countries. "Emissaries, you have worked hard for coming all the way. On behalf of the Dragon Kingdom, I welcome you all. I hope that our two countries can always be friends and share peace."
The envoy from the Black Sun Kingdom put down his wine glass and said with a smile. "You're welcome, Prime Minister. We are here this time to conclude a hundred-year peace treaty with the Dragon Kingdom. As long as the Dragon Kingdom is willing to agree to our conditions, we promise not to invade an inch of the Dragon Kingdom's land within a hundred years."
Long Xingbu was overjoyed when he heard this and said quickly. "Okay, okay, as long as peace can be achieved, everything is negotiable."
Yuan Tiangang stood aside with his brows furrowed and his eyes scanning the envoys from the five countries warily. He could feel that these people were exuding a strong murderous aura, especially the envoys of the Black Sun Kingdom, and the smell of blood on their bodies could hardly be concealed. He knew that a huge disaster was quietly approaching.
After the banquet, Yuan Tiangang immediately asked to see Long Xingbu and wanted to give him advice again, but Long Xingbu refused his request on the grounds of physical discomfort. Yuan Tiangang stood at the entrance of the palace, looking at the majestic palace, heaving a long sigh, his eyes full of despair.
In Tianyuan Academy, a team of seven people was also discussing the matter of the five-nation mission. "I always feel that these people come with bad intentions." Yang Jian said with a frown. "Especially the envoy from the Black Sun Country, he looks at people like poisonous snakes, which makes people feel uncomfortable all over."
"What are you afraid of? With our four war gods here, they can still turn the world upside down." Wukong said nonchalantly. "If they dare to play any tricks, I will smash their heads with one stick."
"You can't say that." Zhuang Zhou shook his head. "The five countries coming at the same time this time must have been premeditated. We cannot take it lightly."
Xiaodie held on to Zhuang Zhou's clothes tightly, her eyes filled with fear. "Zhuang Zhou, I'm so scared. I always feel that something bad is going to happen."
Zhuang Zhou gently patted Xiaodie's head and comforted her softly. "Don't be afraid, I'm here and I will protect you."
But his heart was full of uneasiness. He knew that no matter how powerful the Four Gods of War were, they could not withstand the machinations of the Five Kingdoms or the plan to massacre the country that had been laid out long ago. He looked out the window at the gloomy sky, his eyes full of confusion and pain. Could it be that we really can only watch the tragedy happen?
